title: Design System: Daak v2 — Dhaka Civic Dispatch & Municipal Enamel

headline.purpose: Authoritative civic wayfinding legibility for dispatch headings, tables, and controls.

body.purpose: High-density operational prose, constrained to 70ch max measure.

mono.purpose: Strictly for GPS coordinates, case IDs, and tabular MM:SS SLA chronometers.

shadows.name: hairline-flat
shadows.purpose: Flat-by-default hairline structural seams (1px solid var(--border-hairline)); zero ghost drop shadows.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Crisp drawer, button, and table-row hover transitions; degrades to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Authority Button
components.description: Primary dispatch and moderation action button in Dhaka Civic Teal.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 12px; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid var(--bg-rail-committed, #0F514A); background-color: var(--bg-rail-committed, #0F514A); color: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: var(--bg-rail-committed-hover, #0B3F3A); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #0F514A); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Emergency SOS Ring Button
components.description: Tactile 5-second cancelable SOS trigger reserved strictly for active distress.
components.css: .ds-sos-ring { width: 148px; height: 148px; border-radius: 999px; border: 4px solid var(--signal-emergency-soft, #FDECEC); background-color: var(--signal-emergency-fill, #C81E2B); color: var(--signal-emergency-on-fill, #FFFFFF); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sos-sub { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-sos-ring:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #0F514A); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: SLA Chronometer Pill
components.description: Tabular monospace SLA elapsed timer pill shifting across normal, warning, and breach tiers.
components.css: .ds-sla-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; background-color: var(--signal-emergency-soft, #FDECEC); color: var(--signal-emergency, #C81E2B); border: 1px solid var(--signal-emergency, #C81E2B); }

components.name: Committed Rail Nav Item
components.description: Navigation item inside the 224px Dhaka Civic Teal dispatch rail.
components.css: .ds-rail-bg { background: var(--bg-rail-committed, #0F514A); padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; width: 220px; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); color: var(--ink-on-rail, #F0F5F3); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.24); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--bg-rail-committed-hover, #0B3F3A); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2DD4BF; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-count { font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Hairline Form Input
components.description: Clean 1px-bordered form control for patrol unit assignment and handover briefings.
components.html: <input class="ds-field-input" type="text" value="Mirpur Patrol-09" aria-label="Assign patrol unit" />
components.css: .ds-field-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 0.875rem; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, #D5DDD9); background-color: var(--bg-surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink-primary, #131C1E); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #0F514A); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Case Surface Panel
components.description: Flat hairline-ruled container replacing shadow-heavy SaaS cards.
components.html:
Dhanmondi · Active

Nearest Thana: Dhanmondi Model Police Station (0.19 km)
components.css: .ds-surface-panel { background-color: var(--bg-surface, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, #D5DDD9); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 14px; color: var(--ink-primary, #131C1E); } .ds-panel-meta { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--ink-secondary, #4B5B5E); }

narrative.overview: Modeled after high-legibility civic wayfinding signage, Dhaka municipal/postal authority teal-green, daylight-first chalk surfaces, and true monsoon-slate dark mode, with strict semantic emergency crimson reserved exclusively for live distress and SLA breaches.
keyCharacteristics: Daylight-first Civic Chalk (#F6F7F4) paired with committed Dhaka Civic Teal (#0F514A) navigation rail and Monsoon Slate (#11171A) dark theme
Public Sans UI typography paired with tabular JetBrains Mono strictly for GPS coordinates, case IDs, and MM:SS SLA chronometers
Hairline-ruled split-deck density and inline collapsible Case Inspector drawer instead of lazy modals or shadow-heavy SaaS cards
Tactile 5-second cancelable SOS Panic Ring and persistent Safe Walk escort beacon within one thumb reach

rules.name: The Emergency Crimson Rule
rules.body: Emergency Crimson (#C81E2B / #F87171) is never used for generic brand decoration, primary CTAs on non-emergency forms, or marketing badges.

rules.name: The Hairline Flat Rule
rules.body: Surfaces use 1px structural hairline borders (--border-hairline) with zero ghost drop shadows.

dos: Do keep tabular numerals (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) on all SLA timers, Safety Scores, and coordinates.
Do use sentence-case active-voice copy and clear synthetic-demo labels.
donts: Don't use ALL-CAPS eyebrows, dark-mode neon cyber-ops gradients, or modal labyrinths over emergency actions.
Don't expose raw snake_case enum codes in user-facing tables or badges.
